resources.name: Bulk crystal structure of Ca3Ru2O7 (Yoshida et al., Phys. Rev. B 72, 054412, 2005)

access.notes: The atomic positions, lattice constants, and space group are taken from this publication. Used to construct both bilayer models.

resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or any open-source DFT code supporting LDA+U, SOC, noncollinear magnetism)

access.notes: The workflow assumes an open-source DFT package with the Dudarev DFT+U scheme available. Quantum ESPRESSO with the SSSP library for LDA pseudopotentials is a suitable choice.

resources.name: LDA pseudopotentials for Ca, Ru, O (e.g., SSSP LDA library)

access.notes: Standard LDA pseudopotentials are publicly available. The agent must select LDA pseudopotentials compatible with the chosen DFT code.
